kind: prior-ranked leader/follower past-return feature and coverage audit; no future outcome experiment
hypothesis: large prior-cap members may absorb information before followers; positive past leader-minus-follower return is a diffusion candidate, not proof of later catch-up
population: full era/level catalogue crossed with available completed-month dates, union observed panel identities; catalogue/source-only flags preserved
ranking: use exact previous calendar month membership and valid positive finite market cap; >=5 resolved members, all caps known and effective date<=origin date; top3 cap descending/security_id ascending fixed before signal month
price: exact origin and signal month-end sessions; positive finite qfq close, listed at both endpoints, nonempty identical adjustment chain; no gap interpolation or next_return column
aggregation: all3 leaders known; followers >=2 known and >=80% of fixed remaining members; equal-weight each known group; candidate=leader mean minus follower mean; strict all-followers-known flag separately
time: origin<signal; candidate observable only signal close in historical proxy; no successor month information or current cap affects ranking
limits: monthly close-to-close descriptive input, not executable return; size proxy not economic leadership; first-release PIT absent; no model/threshold search
validation: independent prior ranks, all return formulas/missing states and full catalogue coverage; future-cap mutation isolation, chain break and unknown-rank adversarial tests
